statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent syncope and transient episodes of cerebral ischemia
There is concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology
The patient has a known diagnosis of sick sinus syndrome
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential bradyarrhythmias or pauses
The associated diagnoses are G45.9, I49.5, and R55
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
